text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A great run in the February Stakes. Though 
victory eluded her, Copano Rickey has made 
a full recovery. She left a powerful 
impression on the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae praised 
each other's hard-fought efforts and 
earned mutual respect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey wanted a rematch, but Hokko 
Tarumae told her she was walking a 
different path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which race would Hokko Tarumae head toward 
next? While pondering where she would go 
and sensing a new flow of ki, Copano 
Rickey set her next sights on the Kashiwa 
Kinen.
